messages.content: Hi, I am Karan. Can you tell me the current status of my Indigo flight? My ticket number is IND4567.

function.name: flight_status_check
function.description: Checks the current status of a flight using the airline, passenger's name, and ticket number. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

airlines.description: The name of the airline for which to check the flight status, such as 'Delta' or 'United'.

person_name.description: The full name or first name of the passenger as it appears on the ticket, in the format 'First Last'. If only one name mentioned assume last name is not specified and instead use LNU

ticket_number.description: The alphanumeric ticket number associated with the passenger's flight booking.
